name: @w6w-apps/landbot
description: Landbot chatbot platform: read channels and customers, send messages and WhatsApp templates, assign conversations to agents or bots, manage customer fields and message webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Landbot is a no-code conversational platform: bots that talk to customers over web chat, WhatsApp and Messenger, with human agents able to take a conversation over. This app drives its Platform API from a workflow.

It reads channels and the customers (conversations) in them, pulls a customer's full message transcript, and sends text, images, locations and approved WhatsApp templates into a conversation. It also moves a conversation around: assign it to yourself, a specific agent or a bot (optionally starting the bot at a chosen node), unassign, archive, block or opt a customer out of WhatsApp.

Per-customer custom fields can be read, created, changed and deleted, so a workflow can feed the data a bot collected into the rest of a stack or seed what a bot should know. Message hooks register a URL that Landbot calls for every message on a channel.

Authentication is one workspace-wide agent token. Channel tokens and hook secrets that Landbot's read endpoints return are never passed back out of this app.
